notes.title: [Event] Create the liteCam Game Video!
notes.content:
We are looking for real users review video on liteCam Game: 100 FPS Game Capture. 
If you are familiar with it and love the program, then please contribute your brilliant knowledge with a 'liteCam Game Review Video' for other Steam users. 
We will pick up the best video and upload it in the main page. 
Also, we will list up your video URL on Store so that more traffic will come to your channel. 

[b][u]Reward[/u][/b] 
[b]To all applicant:[/b]
[list]
[*]1 liteCam Game Steam Keys. 
Or 
[*]1 liteCam HD Key  
Or
[*] 1 liteCam Android Key
[/list]
[b] Best Video Producer[/b]
[list]
[*] One STEAM Game under $50.00 of your choice
[/list]
[b][u]Requirements:[/u][/b]
[olist]
[*]Video length should be at least 2 minutes. 
[*]Video Title should be include the "liteCam Game"
[*]Description should be included; liteCam Game:
[list]
[*]http://www.litecam.net/en/product/litecam-game/[/list]
[*]Provide all videos in the highest resolution you have, up to 1920 x 1080 resolution, 30/29.97 or 60/59.94 fps, high bit rate (5,000+ Kbps) and in .avi or .mp4 or .wmv format. 4:3 aspect ratio is also acceptable but not preferred since the Steam client is optimized for widescreen.  
[/olist]

[b][u]Submission:[/u][/b] 
To submit your video, contact us at litecam@rsupport.com, and we will provide you with URL to upload it. 


[i]This event is valid until 15th September 2014.[/i]

Thank you
liteCam Team

notes.title: liteCam 100FPS Game Capture Patch Released
notes.content:
Hello

A patch for liteCam 100FPS Game Capture has been released. 
Released version is liteCam 100FPS Game Capture version 4.8.0.4

[u]Updated features:[/u]
[*]Dual Sound recording setting added.
[*]DirectX/OpendGL hooking Module fixed.
[*]Size of FPS Counter/overlay reduced by 30% 

[b] REMARKS[/b]
Update your liteCam Version installed on your computer and try to record you game play or any activities on your Computer screen.

If you encounter any issues, crashes, features not working well, etc
Let us know the game titles,
Also, send us your Computer system information and liteCam log files

How to create and export below 2 files; 
1. System Information 
Please note this is the default location if you do not change the steam library. 
1-1) For 64 bit windows; 
C:\Program Files (x86)\Steam\SteamApps\common\liteCam Game\Info.exe 
1-2) For 32 bit windows: 
C:\Program Files\Steam\SteamApps\common\liteCam Game\Info.exe 
2) You will be prompted with the 「System - Info」 dialog box. Click File > Save from the dialog box. This will save your system information as a TXT file and you can send this file. 

2. *.log” files 
You will find the “Logs” directory from liteCam’s work directory in your system. (\My Documents\liteCam\Log's Directory) There will be “*.log” files saved in the directory. 

Zip them file and send to litecam@rsupport.com


Thank you
liteCam Team
